summary: Moujaes et al. 2024 (Biol Psychiatry Cogn Neurosci Neuroimaging): direct comparison of psilocybin, LSD, hypnosis, meditation rs-fcMRI. No single network reaches significance across all four ASC methods. Hypnosis & meditation show distinct functional connectivity from psychedelics and each other; patterns are individually predictive.
content: Moujaes, Demertzi et al. 2024 (Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging 9(5):533-543). Directly compared pharmacological ASC (psilocybin n=23; LSD n=25) and non-pharmacological ASC (hypnosis n=30; meditation n=29) using resting state functional connectivity MRI + machine learning. Results: (i) no network reaches significance in all four ASC methods; (ii) pharmacological and non-pharmacological interventions show distinct connectivity patterns that are predictive at the individual level; (iii) hypnosis and meditation show differences in functional connectivity when compared directly, and drive distinct differences when jointly compared to pharmacological ASC; (iv) psilocybin and LSD show no differences when directly compared. Conclusion: extends understanding of ASC mechanisms, highlights importance of exploring how effects can be leveraged in psychiatric treatment.
